text:
Alex: FYI team — final cutover for v2.4.0 is 18:00 UTC today. Please run a quick branch sanity and flaky-test scrub on release/v2.4-rc. Ping here if you have late cherry-picks or blockers.

Mira: Starting a green sweep on release/v2.4-rc now. I'll post failures and rerun notes. :eyes:

buildkite: Pipeline triggered for release/v2.4-rc — smoke + integration + macos matrix. https://ci.internal/builds/78901

Jamal: Seeing intermittent flakes: `tests/e2e/session_timeout_test.py::test_reconnect` and `tests/infra/test_queue_backpressure.py` failing on macos-12. Repro is noisy locally.

Lina: For cutoff etiquette: prefer non-invasive workarounds. Either label flaky tests `[flake]` to remove from blocking suite or add `@pytest.mark.xfail` with an issue reference. Authors can cherrypick fixes to `release/v2.4-rc` and add the `release:cherry-pick` label.

Mira: Sweep results: 3 failing jobs:
- integration-macos-12: `test_reconnect` (socket reconnect timing)
- integration-linux-arm: `test_queue_backpressure` (timing sensitive)
- smoke: `api_version_header_test` (transient 502)

Mira: Rerunning the failing jobs now (will do up to 5 reruns where needed).

sre-bot: Reminder: release window health check at 17:15 UTC — automated alert if >2 failing jobs persist.

Jamal: Reran macos job 5x: failures 2/5 for `test_reconnect`. Looks like a race. I'll open a hotfix PR that adds a brief `wait_for_connection` stabilization.

Mira: linux-arm passed on rerun, smoke passed. Only macos e2e remains failing.

Jamal: Opening PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/repo/pulls/5459 — hotfix adds `wait_for_connection(timeout=3)` and a flake comment. Tagging @Alex @Mira.

Lina: If the hotfix lands within ~45m we can accept as a cherrypick into the RC. Otherwise fall back to marking the test as flaky for the blocking job.

buildkite: PR pipeline passed: https://ci.internal/builds/78925 — merged by Jamal.

Mira: Cherry-pick into release/v2.4-rc successful, final green sweep queued.

Alex: Final reminder — cutoff 18:00 UTC. Last-minute blockers post here; if none we'll tag and build at cutoff. Thanks everyone :rocket:
